output_list.criticism: The stake function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is added to the stakes mapping without a check, which could lead to a very large amount being staked.
The unstake function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is subtracted from the stakes mapping without a check, which could lead to a very large amount being unstaked.
The getReward function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The reward is added to the rewards mapping without a check, which could lead to a very large amount being rewarded.
